Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
Controls: L-drag horiz (0.25,0.42->0.65,0.42); C-click (0.5,0.42); T-play (0.85,0.5); 2-5s waits. Mechanics obs: static L1-1-1 (light green bg, top '1-1-1', dashed track+solid middle/right boxes, bottom open green circles); no path line/fill/anim/start/result. Nav: drag left circle, confirm, play. Failed: horiz drags at y~0.35 no vis path reg; clicks/plays/waits no circle change. Goals: path register/fill, confirm+play?, success cue/async delay. Unresolved: timing/confirm/submit, fill vs level change, static vs delay. Evidence: unchanged open circles after multi drags/clicks/plays/waits (pre-latest); drag 0.25,0.35-0.65,0.35 no fill; C-click 0.5,0.42 done; play 0.85,0.5 executed; latest wait 5s identical screen; drag+click 0.5,0.42 executed (completed) but screen unchanged (open circles). Latest: C-click (0.5,0.42) completed but no visible change (open circles remain). Distinction: all screen states direct obs; no private game state inferred. Guesses: drag+confirm may fill path, play launches with delay.
